support.heading: Support
support.intro: Here are answers to the most common issues players run into. Can't find what you need? Email us directly — we reply within 1–2 business days.

items.question: Why do I get logged out every time I open the app?
items.answer: This is a known issue related to how Riot Games handles token expiration. Workaround: go to App Settings → Log Out → sign back in with your Riot account. We're actively working on improving login persistence in a future update.

items.question: I linked my Riot account but my data isn't showing up?
items.answer: Double-check that your Riot ID is entered correctly (including the #XXXXX suffix). Some regional Valorant accounts can take a few minutes to sync. If nothing appears after 5 minutes, try logging out and back in.

items.question: The shop in the app doesn't match the game?
items.answer: Shop data is sourced from the Riot Games API and typically updates within 5–10 minutes of the daily reset. If the data appears stale, pull to refresh or restart the app.

items.question: I'm not getting shop update notifications?
items.answer: Check two things: (1) "Shop Notifications" is enabled in DailyVal's in-app settings; (2) your iPhone allows DailyVal to send notifications — go to iPhone Settings → Notifications → DailyVal → Allow Notifications.

items.question: My recent matches aren't showing up?
items.answer: The Riot Games API sometimes delays reporting recent matches by 30 minutes to a few hours. This is an upstream data limitation, not a DailyVal issue. Please check back later.

items.question: Can I look up other players?
items.answer: Yes. Enter their Riot ID in the search bar (format: Name#TAG) to view their public rank and match history.

items.question: My purchase didn't activate?
items.answer: Confirm that your Apple ID billing info is up to date, then restart the app. If the issue persists, check App Store → Account → Purchase History to confirm the transaction went through. For refunds, contact Apple Support directly.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Email <email>support@dailyval.com</email> with your Riot ID and a request to delete your account. We'll process it within 7 business days.

items.question: I want to report a bug or suggest a feature
items.answer: We'd love to hear from you. Email <email>support@dailyval.com</email> with the steps to reproduce the issue or your suggestion — we read every message.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: Still stuck? Email <email>support@dailyval.com</email> with your Riot ID and a description of the issue. We'll get back to you within 1–2 business days.
